snippet.title: Moorfall — Announcement Trailer | Real-Time Strategy (PC
snippet.description:
Schwarzmoor has broken into Grimmwald. Take the moor back — village by village.
⚔ Wishlist on Steam: [ https://store.steampowered.com/app/5203000/Moorfall/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer ]

Moorfall is a top-down real-time strategy game about captains, not construction sites. You place no buildings and balance no economy: you lead up to three captains across a fogged moor, call volunteers to arms from the villages you hold, and take the enemy's ground before he takes yours. Outnumber a village badly enough and it surrenders without a fight — misjudge it, and you lose the men you brought.

Word of the war spreads: four banners will fight over the moor. And somewhere out there, a dodo is still alive.

Full English and German. Coming to PC on Steam in 2027.
